setup: TX LO-null biases for the RX-port leakage measurement, fresh for every LO (nothing reused): LMX drive 0, TX filter = optimal for an output 1 GHz above the LO, case closed (shipped), fan ON (LMX settled ~68 C before the start). FieldFox source OFF. TX-side FR3 RF Out -> FR3 cable -> FieldFox. 2LO read only up to 26.5 GHz.
readings: LO and 2LO at TX-side FR3 RF Out, FR3 cable corrected; 1 MHz span, RBW 10 kHz, 30 dB att, no averaging, peak search, continuous sweep ON
